requirements.title: STOPPED_IMAGES argument restrictions
requirements.definition: TEAM shall be scalar TEAM_TYPE identifying the current or an ancestor team; absent TEAM specifies the current team; KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

pending.STOPPED_IMAGES-absent-TEAM-current: Source fact only: absent TEAM specifies the current team. No STOPPED_IMAGES call is planned because all runtime observations of this intrinsic are OUT OF SCOPE by user decision.
pending.STOPPED_IMAGES-KIND-scalar-integer-const: Source fact only: KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression. A source-control mutation uses a nonconstant KIND expression, and no diagnostic facet is claimed.
